notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo.4576.822
notes.content:
Heya Collectors!

We have another smaller patch ready for you all!

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue that would cause island save data to not be completely deleted when starting a new trip while an island was active
[*] This issue led to some objects being placed in wrong spots on affected islands (e.g. Rune Stones)
[*] Fixed special conditions for Fabled Clownfish and Fabled Butterflyfish not considering decorations placed in the boat interior
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation in chest menu not navigating to player inventory under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed player companion missing sleep vfx on islands
[*] Fixed Player Guide Secret Seller page translations for German, Spanish and Japanese to more accurately reflect how it works[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo.4562.817
notes.content:
Hello Collectors!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/f5cc45e647ce0b96c7560e8c54ad5e68e26414e6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/4662a991bff27785cdd17ba8eaf0dc5a202fa880.png[/img][/url]

Here is our first patch for the demo with several critical fixes and adjustments!

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed an issue that could softlock the game in an infinite loading screen when going inside the boat while an island was being generated
[*]Fixed an issue that could softlock the game when opening the compendium through the discovery popup during certain activities (fishing, building, flotsam)
[*]Fixed flickering water on certain GPUs
If you still experience issues with the water, please let us know!
[*]Fixed a bridge not being walkable on one specific island in a very specific configuration
[*]Fixed some drag drop operations working even when used on disabled inventory slots
[*]Fixed fish spawn times not being displayed correctly when cycling through fish in compendium
[*]Updated French translation for Fabled Clownfish special condition to more accurately reflect the condition[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Changed treasure puzzle runes to glow by default and stop glowing when activated in an attempt to improve readability
[*]Changed tiki statue rune for resources to improve readability[/list]

notes.title: Collector's Cove DEMO is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Ahoy, Collectors! The day has come!![/h3][p][/p][p]We're incredibly excited to share that the [b]first-ever demo of Collector’s Cove is now live[/b]!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/4662a991bff27785cdd17ba8eaf0dc5a202fa880.png"][/img][/p][p]And even better: it’s launching as part of the[b] Wholesome Direct 2025[/b]!
We couldn’t dream of a better occasion to welcome you aboard for your first cozy journey in Collector's Cove! 
[/p][h2]New trailer just dropped![/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="203iLkvIwdk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/434c31cdcd90d39470da6e1e53a8d9c8807d7f9f.png"][/img][/h2][h2]What can you do in the demo?[/h2][list][*][p] Explore the first climate zone, with its own islands, flora & treasures[/p][/*][*][p] Upgrade and personalize your boat with cozy decorations[/p][/*][*][p] Fishing, farming and foraging[/p][/*][*][p] Bond with your animal companion and customize them[/p][/*][*][p] Begin filling out your Collector’s Compendium with all your discoveries
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/9329d354e4f13609293d45e7b39aa4f5e17574c6.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Soak in the sounds of the sea and begin gathering fabled fish & crops to catalog your cozy journey, all at your own pace. There's no rush! Just peace and quiet as you discover this new world and its small joys along the way.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/f14829bad6dd044cf93c774fe28b4b7fbea7e396.png"][/img][/p][h2]Updated store page![/h2][p]
We’ve also just updated our store page with a brand-new trailer, screenshots, and GIFs, all showcasing the latest additions, visual improvements and updated UI we’ve been working on! 🌟
Take a look for a fresh peek at how life is going to be aboard your homey floating farm!!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2867470/Collectors_Cove/"][/dynamiclink] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/19c40a67c8ac271ab66654187d885d3568c1df48.png"][/img][/p][h2]We’d love your thoughts[/h2][p]
If you play the demo, we’d truly appreciate it if you took a moment to share your thoughts with us; there are plenty of ways to do so!
[/p][list][*][p]Our [url="https://discord.gg/24e8XVSmXj"]Discord[/url]! This is where the team is the most present and reactive.[/p][/*][*][p]Our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2867470/discussions/"]Steam community forum[/url].[/p][/*][*][p]By tagging us on our socials, either on [url="https://x.com/VoodooDuckGames"]Twitter / X[/url] or [url="https://bsky.app/profile/voodooduckgames.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url]![/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback helps us make Collector’s Cove the best it can be.

Thank you for sailing with us. We hope this first taste of Collector’s Cove brings you some warmth and joy 🧡

[/p]
